name: Dr. Bradley Nelson
reason: Health rule: his own site (discoverhealing.com, home page read 4 Nov 2026) sells the Emotion Code, Body Code and Belief Code as energy healing that finds the 'root cause' of imbalances so the body can heal, with home-page testimonials claiming results such as migraines and restored eyesight after a session; the Body Code is framed around physical health, and his Shift course was 'Activate Health, Abundance & Love', so almost nothing passes the strict health rule. The site is also a certification company (Discover Healing) rather than a personal teaching site.
